merchant.canon: 120-chapter Water Margin15 appearance: strong hands, large eyes, worn tilted headcloth, temple pomegranate flower and ONE blue-green leopard on chest, not back. Chapter16: seven merchants stripped to cool in pine shade and all carried pu-dao. Bare upper body only explicit hn_ruan_xiaowu stage. Right flower side, exact face/beard/trousers/shoes, pu-dao dimensions, hold side and optional generic defeat moves are conservative art/game design, not added novel events or final fate. Ordinary clothed identity and carry/boat variants remain separate.
